record.field: Create or update a CRM lead only when there is a real commercial signal. Before calling this tool, classify the lead temperature as cold/warm/hot. Do not create leads for cold conversations or casual questions without concrete follow-up intent. Create/update only when warm/hot and there is actionable contact/progression data.

result = { 'success': True, 'lead_id': False, 'message': '', 'created': False, 'updated': False, 'skipped': False, } try: from markupsafe import Markup import re room_id = room.id if room else False agent_id = agent.id if agent else False def _clean(value): if value is None: return '' return str(value).strip() def _normalize_plain_text(value): text = _clean(value) if not text: return '' # Some providers send HTML snippets; normalize to plain text blocks. text = re.sub(r'', '\n', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) text = re.sub(r'', '\n', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) text = re.sub(r']*>', '', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text) lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()] return '\n'.join(lines) # Get parameters name = _clean(params.get('name')) or (room.display_name if room else False) or 'Lead from chat' contact_name = _clean(params.get('contact_name')) email = _clean(params.get('email')).lower() phone = _clean(params.get('phone')) description = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('description')) intent_signal = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('intent_signal')) lead_temperature = _clean(params.get('lead_temperature')).lower() sentiment_summary = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('sentiment_summary')) preferred_contact_time = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('preferred_contact_time')) next_action = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('next_action')) connector_type = _clean(room.connector_id.connector_type if room and room.connector_id else False).lower() # Only infer phone from room.external_id for channels where external_id is the phone (e.g. Evolution/WhatsApp). room_external_id = _clean(room.external_id if room else False) if not phone and connector_type in ('evolution',) and room_external_id: normalized_room_phone = ''.join( c for c in room_external_id if c.isdigit() or c == '+' ) digits_count = sum(1 for c in normalized_room_phone if c.isdigit()) if digits_count >= 8: phone = normalized_room_phone if lead_temperature not in ('cold', 'warm', 'hot'): lead_temperature = '' def _build_note(base_description): parts = [] if base_description: parts.append(base_description) if intent_signal: parts.append(f"Intent signal: {intent_signal}") if lead_temperature: parts.append(f"Lead temperature: {lead_temperature}") if sentiment_summary: parts.append(f"Sentiment: {sentiment_summary}") if preferred_contact_time: parts.append(f"Preferred contact time: {preferred_contact_time}") if next_action: parts.append(f"Next action: {next_action}") # crm.lead.description is HTML-friendly in many setups; use visible line breaks. return '
'.join(parts).strip() note_text = _build_note(description) # Qualification guardrails: skip creation for weak/early intent. joined_text = ' '.join([ name, description, intent_signal, next_action, sentiment_summary, ]).lower() explicit_create = any( token in joined_text for token in [ 'crear lead', 'create lead', 'contactame', 'contáctame', 'llamame', 'llámame', 'cotizacion', 'cotización', 'financiacion', 'financiación', 'test ride', 'prueba de manejo', 'comprar', 'señar', 'reserva', ] ) has_contact_data = bool(contact_name or email or phone) has_detailed_need = len(description) >= 25 # Heuristic fallback for temperature if model did not send it. if not lead_temperature: if explicit_create and has_contact_data: lead_temperature = 'hot' elif has_contact_data and has_detailed_need: lead_temperature = 'warm' else: lead_temperature = 'cold' # Never create cold leads. if lead_temperature == 'cold': result['success'] = False result['skipped'] = True result['message'] = 'Lead skipped: temperature is cold.' raise ValueError(result['message']) if not ((explicit_create and has_contact_data) or (has_contact_data and has_detailed_need)): result['success'] = False result['skipped'] = True result['message'] = ( 'Lead skipped: insufficient qualification for warm/hot lead.' ) raise ValueError(result['message']) probability_by_temp = { 'warm': 40.0, 'hot': 70.0, } priority_by_temp = { 'warm': '1', 'hot': '2', } # Try to find a probable duplicate first. duplicate_domain = [('type', '=', 'opportunity')] if email: duplicate_domain.append(('email_from', '=', email)) elif phone: duplicate_domain.append(('phone', '=', phone)) elif contact_name: duplicate_domain.append(('contact_name', 'ilike', contact_name)) else: duplicate_domain.append(('name', 'ilike', name)) existing_lead = env['crm.lead'].search(duplicate_domain, limit=1, order='id desc') if existing_lead: update_vals = {} if contact_name and not existing_lead.contact_name: update_vals['contact_name'] = contact_name if email and not existing_lead.email_from: update_vals['email_from'] = email if phone and not existing_lead.phone: update_vals['phone'] = phone if description: previous = existing_lead.description or '' if note_text and note_text not in previous: update_vals['description'] = ( f"{previous}\n\n[AI update]\n{note_text}".strip() ) if update_vals: existing_lead.write(update_vals) # Upgrade commercial priority based on latest temperature. current_probability = existing_lead.probability or 0.0 target_probability = probability_by_temp.get(lead_temperature, current_probability) if target_probability > current_probability: existing_lead.write({'probability': target_probability}) target_priority = priority_by_temp.get(lead_temperature) if target_priority and (existing_lead.priority or '0') < target_priority: existing_lead.write({'priority': target_priority}) if room_id and 'chatroom_room_ids' in env['crm.lead']._fields: existing_lead.write({'chatroom_room_ids': [(4, room_id)]}) result['lead_id'] = existing_lead.id result['updated'] = True result['message'] = f'Existing lead updated (ID: {existing_lead.id})' lead = existing_lead else: # Create lead lead_vals = { 'name': name, 'contact_name': contact_name or False, 'email_from': email or False, 'phone': phone or False, 'description': note_text, 'type': 'opportunity', 'probability': probability_by_temp.get(lead_temperature, 0.0), 'priority': priority_by_temp.get(lead_temperature, '0'), } # Link to chat room if available if room_id and 'chatroom_room_ids' in env['crm.lead']._fields: lead_vals['chatroom_room_ids'] = [(4, room_id)] # Link to partner if chat has linked contacts if room and room.partner_ids: lead_vals['partner_id'] = room.partner_ids[0].id lead = env['crm.lead'].create(lead_vals) result['lead_id'] = lead.id result['created'] = True result['message'] = f'Lead "{name}" created successfully (ID: {lead.id})' # Add message with creation info if room_id and agent_id: agent = env['chatroom.ai.agent'].browse(agent_id) chat_url = f"/web#action=chatroom.action_chatroom_app&room_id={room_id}" action_txt = 'created' if result['created'] else 'updated' message_body = f'''

This lead was automatically {action_txt} by AI agent {agent.name} from a chat conversation.

View source chat conversation

''' lead.message_post( body=Markup(message_body), subject='Lead managed by AI', message_type='notification', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', ) except Exception as e: if not result.get('skipped'): result['success'] = False result['message'] = f'Error creating/updating lead: {str(e)}'
